manifest.description: Analyze a GenServer module: infer state schema from init/1, report per-callback state-field reads/writes via the recognized syntactic catalog, surface unresolved access sites for operator review. Analysis-only; precondition for elixir-split-genserver.
when_to_use: about to run elixir-split-genserver and want to inspect state-field reach across callbacks first
diagnostic: identify which callbacks touch which state fields to plan a clean concern partition
anti_patterns: do not use as a permission grant; analysis is honestly advisory at indexed_hints tier (deepseek R2-C1)
do not trust state_field_touches for callback isolation without reviewing state_field_touches_unresolved manually

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-genserver-state-audit.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_genserver_state_audit", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}").
2. Surface state_fields, per_callback {reads, writes}, init_initializers, state_field_touches_unresolved.
3. When state_field_touches_unresolved is non-empty, recommend the operator review before chaining into elixir-split-genserver.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done").

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}}
